preconditions.description: The number of distinct integers m must be between 1 and 31.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ai <= 30 for ai in S)
preconditions.description: Each integer ai in the set S must be between 0 and 30.
All elements in the set S must be distinct.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '=(' if not valid_tournament else True
postconditions.description: If no valid tournament exists, the output must be the string '=('.
If a valid tournament exists, the number of vertices n must be at least m.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(row) == d for row, d in zip(matrix, scores))
postconditions.description: The sum of each row in the matrix must equal the corresponding score in the sorted scores list.
